text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик takes the Kikuka crown and
rushes
back to me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We bask in the glory of a victory earned
through
the power of our bond.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind the Classics that taught
us so
much, we set our sights on the
Nakayama
racecourse winter race—the
Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
